query: SELECT DISTINCT character.name AS "name!: String" FROM message              JOIN history_entry ON history_entry.id = message.id              JOIN agent_history ON agent_history.branch_id = history_entry.branch_id              LEFT JOIN player_character ON player_character.agent_id = agent_history.agent_id              LEFT JOIN npc_agent ON npc_agent.agent_id = agent_history.agent_id              JOIN character ON character.id = COALESCE(player_character.character_id, npc_agent.character_id)              WHERE message.action_id = ? AND character.id <> ? ORDER BY character.name
